fact: Revenue Services Lesotho's guide says taxpayers can complete and submit CIT, IIT, RIIT, T&E, VAT and PAYE returns online through its e-Taxation platform (e-Filing).

Revenue Services Lesotho's guide says tax payments can be made through its e-Payments platform using mobile money (EcoCash and M-Pesa) and by bank EFT, with Standard Lesotho Bank payments via the Unayo app reflected immediately in the RSL system.
